description: Split conversions by which conversion action fired, so lead-gen accounts can see which keywords or campaigns produce the event the business is actually paid on (approval, disbursal, qualified opportunity) rather than just form fills. Essential when offline conversions are imported: the cheapest cost-per-lead is often the worst source of funded business.

downstream_action.description: Name of the conversion action that represents the outcome (defaults to the offline-imported one)

level.description: Break down by keyword or campaign

name: google_ads_conversion_funnel
